title: Fixed ring and driven sun
question: Drive S CW. Determine the motion of P (spin) and H (orbit) at the shown instant. Use the labeled contact views.

answer.explanation: Drive S CW. External mesh S/P (30/30 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. S positive, P negative. Internal mesh P/R (30/90 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. P negative, R held. R is locked to the frame. R held. 30 × (S − H) + 30 × (P − H) = 0. 30 × (P − H) − 90 × (R − H) = 0. The requested motion is CCW / CW (in listed output order).

options.label: A
options.explanation: P must be CCW. External mesh S/P (30/30 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. S positive, P negative. Internal mesh P/R (30/90 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. P negative, R held..

options.label: B
options.explanation: P must be CCW. External mesh S/P (30/30 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. S positive, P negative. Internal mesh P/R (30/90 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. P negative, R held.. H must be CW. External mesh S/P (30/30 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. S positive, P negative. Internal mesh P/R (30/90 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. P negative, R held..

options.label: C
options.explanation: All requested motions agree with the contact constraints.

options.label: D
options.explanation: H must be CW. External mesh S/P (30/30 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. S positive, P negative. Internal mesh P/R (30/90 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. P negative, R held..
